Field.Label: Lost device notification delay (seconds):
Field.Description: Delay unavailable logging. Recovery within this period suppresses both messages. 0 logs immediately; for example, use 60 to suppress brief outages. Offline state updates remain immediate.

Field.Label: Request timeout (seconds):
Field.Description: Time allowed for each RainMachine API request (1-300; default 30). Restart the plugin after changing this setting.
